messages:
emily: Quick Q  I'm planning to take parental leave starting 2026-09-01 but I'm also doing a short international move to care for family during that period. Do I need to notify payroll/immigration separately for benefits and visa implications?
people-ops: Congrats, Emily! :tada: Short answer: yes, please notify payroll and legal. If you're out of country for >30 days the payroll tax withholding and benefits residency rules may change. Start by filing the standard Parental Leave request and add a note about international travel.
emily: Filed the leave request and added the "international" note. Anything specific legal needs?
legal: Hi Emily  please DM us your destination country and visa status. For some countries we need to pause certain benefits (e.g., commuter benefits, local insurance supplements) and update taxation forms. We'll confirm whether your equity paperwork needs any address update.
michelle: Payroll note: if you're taxed as non-resident or pay date changes, we may need a local tax form. Also, if Redwood is not providing payroll in that jurisdiction, you'll receive payments in USD via our standard vendor flow and may owe local taxes — we'll coordinate with you. Use code INT-PL-09 on your leave form so payroll & benefits teams link it.
raj: For coverage, I can take on Emily's on-call weeks 2-4 and pair with @michelle for cost approvals. Emily, do you want us to post a short handoff doc in the team channel?
emily: Yes please, a 1-page handoff would be great. Include runbooks and the two outstanding PRs.
people-ops: Also note: childcare subsidy eligibility requires U.S. residency during payout. If you're outside the U.S. for the payout period, subsidy may be paused. We'll include that in the follow-up email.
legal: If you're on an employment visa sponsored by Redwood, travel might affect sponsorship. DM us the visa type so we can advise.
emily: I'm on an H-1B currently and will be traveling to Canada for 6 weeks. Not leaving sponsorship permanently.
legal: H-1B outside US > brief travel ok, but you may need to reenter with valid docs. For payroll/tax we need dates and passport country to advise precisely.
michelle: Next steps: 1) emily confirm travel dates in DM to legal/payroll 2) people-ops will flag leave as INT-PL-09 so benefits team sees it 3) raj/michelle publish handoff doc and rota 4) legal to confirm any visa concerns.
hr-bot: Reminder: attach travel dates within 3 business days to avoid delays in benefit payout.
emily: Done  sent dates and passport info to legal + payroll. Thanks everyone. :heart:
